description: Purpose of this region: what is still open — tasks and ideas, who is on them, and where they stand.
content:
This region tracks work that has not been settled yet.

Belongs here: what is to be done, why, who owns it, its current state and what blocks it; ideas and proposals nobody has acted on yet. Use a follow-up date on an entry that must be returned to; it will surface in every recall until the entry is read.

Does not belong here: temporary notes and handovers (scope.scratchpad), anything already done, learned or decided (scope.knowledge), or a rule that is to be followed from now on (scope.instructions).

Several agents may work here at once. Say plainly in an entry when you have taken it on, so two do not do the same work twice.

When an entry is finished or turned down, record the outcome in scope.knowledge if it is worth remembering, and rate the entry down so it fades rather than deleting it.
